summary: Production readiness checklist for enterprise upload, malware scanning and controlled-document tenant isolation. Code controls are implemented; production readiness requires live environment configuration and runtime validation before marking complete.
redactionConfirmation: No secrets, tokens, credentials, scanner endpoints or access-granting values are stored in this evidence file.

productionValidationScenarios.expected: A valid PDF upload is accepted only after the scanner returns a clean verdict.
When REQUIRE_MALWARE_SCAN_FOR_UPLOADS=true and the scanner is unreachable, upload is blocked before storage.
Infected, suspicious or scanner error verdicts block upload before storage.
Files whose claimed MIME, extension and magic number do not agree are rejected before scanning/storage.
An actor from another organization cannot receive a signed URL for a controlled document.
Authenticated clients cannot directly read, upload, update or delete controlled document objects through Supabase storage policies.
Upload scan outcomes and denied signed-download attempts emit structured audit events with organizationId and actorUserId.

goNoGoRule: Do not mark enterprise upload/document readiness as 100% until every productionValidationScenarios item is Complete in the target production environment and the two required Supabase migrations are applied.
